name: Khan Academy
summary:
Khan Academy is the free-lesson site at khanacademy.org. The green leaf mark in the tab is the icon course bookmarks use.

Checked 12 November 2026 against khanacademy.org. HTML came from https://www.khanacademy.org/ (HTTP 200). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.khanacademy.org/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 4286 bytes. Directory sizes: 32×32.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

The only measured sizes are inside favicon.ico: 32×32.
